# The shaping test cases of sdl3-ttf (src/tests.rs), which the C program
# that made shaping_reference.txt runs too. A `font FILE` line starts the
# cases of a font in fonts/ (`font FILE FALLBACK` adds a fallback font);
# a case is `case DIR SCRIPT LANG KERN TEXT`, tab-separated: the direction
# (ltr, rtl, ttb, btt), the ISO 15924 script and the BCP 47 language set
# on the font (`-` for none), whether kerning is on, and the text, with
# `\xNN` escapes for bytes that are not valid UTF-8.
font NotoSans-Regular.ttf
case	-	-	-	1	office affine fluffy ffl ffi
case	-	-	-	1	AVATAR Wave To Yo! 1/2 T.V.
case	-	-	-	0	AVATAR Wave To Yo! 1/2 T.V.
case	-	-	-	1	é ạ̈ ñ q̣̇ Å
case	rtl	-	-	1	Hello, world
case	-	Latn	tr	1	fi ı i fl
case	ttb	-	-	1	Vertical
case	-	-	-	1	ab\xff\xfecd \xc3\x28 \xe2\x82 x\xf0\x9f\x98
font NotoSansArabic-Regular.ttf NotoSans-Regular.ttf
case	-	-	-	1	السلام عليكم
case	-	-	-	1	بِسْمِ ٱللَّٰهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
case	-	-	-	1	لا لأ لإ لآ عـــربي
case	-	-	-	0	کتاب فارسی ۱۲۳
case	-	-	fa	1	۴۵۶ ٤٥٦ گچپژ
case	-	-	ur	1	۴۵۶ ٤٥٦ اردو
case	-	-	-	1	مرحبا Hello ١٢٣ world
case	ltr	-	-	1	عربي
case	-	Arab	-	1	123 abc
case	-	-	-	1	عر\xd8ب\xffي
font NotoSansHebrew-Regular.ttf NotoSans-Regular.ttf
case	-	-	-	1	שָׁלוֹם עוֹלָם
case	-	-	-	1	בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים
case	-	-	-	0	בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים
case	-	-	-	1	אִם־יִהְיֶה (abc) 123
case	-	-	-	1	Hello שלום world
case	rtl	-	-	1	abc שלום

case	-	-	-	0	क्षत्रिय र्क र्क्ष श्री
case	-	-	-	1	कि कीं क़ि ज़्
case	-	-	-	1	हिन्दी 123 abc
case	-	-	-	1	ि ् क्‍ष क्‌ष
case	-	Deva	mr	1	र्‍य र्य
